title: Verify browser behavior and external data with attributable check evidence
goal: Make BrowserScenario and ExternalQuery executable sources of evidence so browser and external-data criteria can be assessed without relying on an agent’s prose.
scope: Implement BrowserRunner for BrowserScenario(script,viewport) against the target snapshot, with an explicit browser environment, bounded lifecycle, necessary process/socket/network/browser permissions and captured outputs/artifact references.

Implement ExternalQuery(source,query) through an explicit CheckRunner execution path with versioned source/query, response capture and attributable environment/source. Cover successful support, applicable contradictory response and unavailable/error cases without equating a transport error with a false criterion.

Map actual browser runs to Browser evidence and actual external results to ExternalData; bind criterion/result/check/snapshot/environment and polarity. Feed independent review, A7 grading/rejection, A8 ledger and ClaimAuditor through the same AcceptanceAuthority consumer.
acceptance: Through AcceptanceAuthority, a real browser fixture distinguishes a rendering/interaction defect from a correct snapshot and records Browser evidence. An external fixture query records supporting and contradicting ExternalData with inspectable source/response references.
Missing browser/network permissions and unavailable sources yield typed Error/denial. Contradicting applicable Browser/ExternalData evidence rejects a candidate despite approving reviewers.

A report’s browser claim is accepted only with Browser evidence; a static read or a fake adapter success cannot satisfy it. The runner replacement contract is exercised through actual consumers with materially different behavior and recorded PolicyRefs.
context: Authority: ymp-docs/self-organizing-team-domain-model.md, sections 3.2 (CheckSpec), 3.6 (EvidenceClass), 5.1 (CheckRunner), A6/A7/A11, R-6/R-9. Use the approved model with 811a872 semantics and the greenfield baseline in 0c61ff1 and §5.8 for experimental strategy boundaries. Other documents and existing names explain implementation facts only.

Greenfield: create this behavior in the new implementation. Paths below are PROPOSED target modules under the layout owned by W1-0001; only completed prerequisite tasks supply implementation. Prior source, APIs, fixtures and delivery claims are not a baseline.

Create proposed crates/ymp-runtime/src/checks/{browser,external}.rs with concrete browser and explicit query-source adapters. W1-0009 supplies checks/evidence and W1-0013 claim audit; W2-0001 supplies hidden-data protection. No prior runner or fixture is credited.

New local fixture pages/query servers can demonstrate real browser/external execution behavior without claiming evidence about an arbitrary live site. Actual native permissions decide Browser/Network/process access before method selection.

Browser/ExternalData evidence is classified from actual runs/responses, never adapter authority. Applicable contradiction defeats approval; unknown transport/environment failures remain Error and cannot be mislabeled as behavioral failure.

history.note: Plan new implementation from greenfield baseline 0c61ff1, preserving approved experimental mechanisms, reporting/evidence/recovery rules and explicit prerequisite boundaries.
Start review 2026-09-16: depend on W1-0019 (evidence/review binding) instead of the narrowed W1-0009.
